stories.title: Malaysia’s data center industry gets 500 MW solar, 1 GWh battery storage boost
stories.description: A 500 MW solar project paired with a 1 GWh battery storage system is planned in Malaysia to supply renewable electricity to DayOne’s data centers. The project, backed by IOI Corporation and Tenaga Nasional Berhad, will operate under the country’s Corporate Renewable Energy Supply Scheme.

stories.title: Poweroad FLEX-261 series passes dual-standard large-scale fire testing
stories.description: Testing was conducted in accordance with UL 9540A and CSA C800 and provides technical evidence to support fire safety assessments for multi-cabinet C&I energy storage installations. POWEROAD has received a CSA Group Letter of Attestation for passing the tests.

stories.description: The interest rate set by the Bank of England affects mortgage, loan and savings rates for millions.

stories.title: Scientists identify two overlooked skills that predict reading success
stories.description: A massive new study reveals that intelligence plays a surprisingly limited role in children's reading success, while visual processing showed no meaningful connection at all. Instead, the strongest predictors are sound recognition, vocabulary, and background knowledge, offering new clues about how to help struggling readers.

stories.title: Scientists discover that some “unhealthy” diets can boost cancer immunotherapy in mice
stories.description: In a surprising discovery, scientists found that certain diets associated with obesity can make cancer immunotherapy more effective in mice, challenging traditional assumptions about diet and cancer treatment. The findings suggest that the secret may lie in how food interacts with gut bacteria to strengthen the immune system's response to cancer.

stories.title: Lithuania moves to revive renewables growth with sweeping reforms
stories.description: Lithuania has approved legislative reforms to accelerate renewable energy development, allowing project extensions of up to 48 months, halving developer guarantees and easing permitting requirements. The measures also aim to speed up grid connections, strengthen infrastructure resilience and tighten energy cybersecurity regulations.
